answer: Entry is a commit-reveal gate bound to a future beacon. Each applicant posts a sealed hash plus a 0.60-unit escrow and a violet audit tag. Two epochs later the beacon publishes its value, applicants reveal the preimage, and it picks 10 percent for a liveness probe. Passing members earn a 0.05-unit nectar rebate per epoch. A failed reveal or probe triggers a ferrous burn of the escrow. Cost: forging N=50 identities locks 30 units; probes fail 5 per epoch, burning 3 units, so 10 epochs erase the full stake, while an honest agent risks one 0.60-unit stake.
